name: ff-factory-runtime
description: Factory Runtime — successor to twin-bridge/, per ADR-001-factory-runtime-twin-lifecycle.md and FACTORY-RUNTIME-MIGRATION-PLAN.md (Factory_To_Foundation/frontend/). Owns the CE Twin's operational lifecycle end to end (invariant #2/#9); twin-bridge is not deleted and stays the authoritative owner until cutover (migration plan §7). Same real-auth dependency shape as twin-bridge — `jose` for JWT verification, matching the backend's own library rather than hand-rolling it.
